name: Stable Unlabeled Complexity / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Every stable unlabeled sample-compression scheme has size at least the maximum no-clashing teaching dimension of a coordinate projection.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star.
witness_verification: For the full n-cube, stable unlabeled complexity is n while \(\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=\lceil n/2\rceil\), so the inequality is strict for every \(n\ge3\).
